title: 第五章 寻剑来战第六章 传说中的天书
lines: 王贤摇摇头，手一晃一把木剑出现在手中。
看着老婆婆问道：“前辈说的是这木剑？这是师父刚刚给我削的。”
澹台小雪伸手接过木剑，放在鼻子下嗅了一下。
嘻嘻笑道：“这剑连杀气都没有！”
老婆婆恨得牙根痒痒，拍着桌子嚷嚷：“老家伙，把你的纳戒交出来。”
老道士笑道：“给你看可以，不过说好了，若是找不到神剑，你得给赔我三千灵石！”
“噗嗤！”
老婆婆刚刚喝的一口茶，瞬间喷了出来。
气得大骂：“你这是穷疯了吗？”
老道士摇摇头，将纳戒搁在桌上：“你明知我是一个穷人，这真要是天上掉下神剑，我早就拿山下换灵石了。”
老婆婆看着王贤低头写字的模样，又看了一眼老道士的纳戒。
不用伸手，只是用神识快速扫了一眼，脸上便露出一抹失望的神情。
她也知道，若是老道士身怀神剑，瞒得了别人，却不可能瞒得了她的眼睛。
想到这里，只好不甘心地叹了一口气。
看着王贤笑道：“小道士，你跟着这老家伙有什么出息，不如跟我去剑宗如何？”
澹台小雨嘻嘻一笑：“师弟跟我回去，让师父给你一把灵剑。”
“你要去吗？”老道士淡然问道。
“不去，没空！”
王贤心里是师父那天斩向天际的一剑！
一张燃烧的符纸，竟然能如神剑一般斩出。
从那一刻起，他的眼里，便再也装不下别人了。
眼见师父皱起了眉头，王贤吓了一跳。
赶紧跟老婆婆回道：“晚辈跟师父习惯了清静，怕去不了热闹的地方。”
老婆婆皱了皱眉头：“你以为这里就清静了，你还有一个不省心的师姐，等她回来，哼！”
接下来的话她没说，她相信眼前的少年能听懂。
澹台小雪抿嘴一笑，没有吭声。
老道士摇摇头：“你们师徒不会想来白吃白喝啊？”
“砰！”的一声。
老婆婆拍了一下面前的桌子，微笑着说道：“跟我过两招，赢了，我便还你灵石。”
老道士摇摇头：“那本来就是你欠我的！”
老婆婆怒道：“我再加五百！”
闻言，老道士放声大笑。
content_en:
Wang Xian shook his head, and a wooden sword appeared in his hand.
He looked at the old woman and asked, "Senior, is this wooden sword you're talking about? Master just whittled it for me."
Tantai Xiaoxue reached out and took the wooden sword, put it under her nose and smelled it.
He chuckled and said, "This sword doesn't even have murderous intent!"
The old woman was so angry that she slapped the table and shouted: "Old guy, hand over your ring."
The old Taoist priest smiled and said: "I can show it to you, but I have agreed that if I can't find the divine sword, you have to pay me three thousand spiritual stones!"
"Pfft!"
The old woman took a sip of tea and spurted it out instantly.
He was so angry that he yelled: "Are you crazy because of poverty?"
The old Taoist priest shook his head and put the ring on the table: "You know that I am a poor man. If a divine sword really fell from the sky, I would have exchanged it for the spiritual stone."
The old woman looked at the way Wang Xian lowered his head to write, and then glanced at the old Taoist priest's ring.
There was no need to reach out, just a quick glance with his consciousness, and a look of disappointment appeared on his face.
She also knew that if the old Taoist priest possessed a divine sword and could hide it from others, it was impossible for him to hide it from her eyes.
Thinking of this, I could only sigh reluctantly.
He looked at Wang Xian and said with a smile: "Little Taoist priest, what's the point of following this old guy? Why don't you go to the Sword Sect with me?"
Tantai Xiaoyu chuckled: "Junior brother, come back with me and ask the master to give you a spiritual sword."
"Are you going?" the old Taoist priest asked calmly.
"No, I don't have time!"
Wang Xian's heart was filled with the sword that Master slashed to the sky that day!
A burning talisman can be slashed like a divine sword.
From that moment on, he could no longer hold anyone else in his eyes.
Wang Xian was startled when he saw his master frowning.
He quickly replied to the old woman: "Junior and Master are used to quietness, and we are afraid that we will not be able to go to busy places."
The old woman frowned: "You think it's quiet here, you still have a worried senior sister, wait for her to come back, hum!"
She didn't say the next words, believing that the boy in front of her could understand.
Tantai Xiaoxue pursed her lips and smiled without saying a word.
The old Taoist priest shook his head: "Don't you, master and disciple, want to come here and eat and drink for free?"
"Bang!"
The old woman patted the table in front of her and said with a smile: "Fight a few tricks with me, and if you win, I will return the spirit stone to you."
The old Taoist priest shook his head: "That's what you owe me!"
The old woman said angrily: "I'll add another five hundred!"
Hearing this, the old Taoist priest laughed loudly.
